title: Tukkikati tool yu naat yi
intro: Bu njëkk, ñaari nit ñoo daan yar dëkk yi leen wër. Seen yoon dafa jaxasoo, waaye seen xol daf leen yóbbu ci barab yu wuute lool. Kenn ki dafa dox ci yoonu jub, beneen bi réer ci lëndëm gu weddi gi. Ndax mën nga leeral kumpa ñaari sàmmkat yii ci góob bi?
clues: Amoon naa ay mbay yu bari, góob yu bari yuy yéem bëti ñiy seetaan.
Sama dëkkandoo amoon na xéewal gu ëpp sama xéewal, waaye maa ngi bëgg seen wàll gëna sama wàll.
Ma digal leen ñu yàq seen mbay yépp, ngir dajale lépp luma yor.
Maa ngi yàq sama góob, yàq lépp ci samay pexe yu doy waar.
Ma taxaw te mënu ma dara, samay mbay di wow, sama alal mujjee nekk pënd ci benn guddi.
Amuma woon benn wàll ci àllaaxira, te sama dëkkuwaay bu mujj dafa doon pax mu tàng.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Ku weddi ndekkite ak àtte
Njiit li daan sonal baykat bu jub bi
Boroom suuf bu am xaalis bi amul ngërëm
Baykat bi bëggoon suufu dëkkandoo
Partenaire bu wor bi defar pexe yàqu-yàqu

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Natt gi ngir jot feeñu Yàlla
Jafe-jafe alal ak muñ
Fiir ngir yàq dundug nit ku jub
Ndigal séddale ndono ci anam wu jaar yoon
Xeex ngir xeex jaay doole
trial.answer: Fiir ngir yàq dundug nit ku jub

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Jardin yu wert yi ci aljanna
Ñaari tool yu dendoo
Tund yi seede yàqu-yàqu
Barab bu sell bu Makkah
Tefesu dexu réew mu barkeel

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Aljanna ba fàww, di neexal njub
Yaxxum ñaari góob yi ci àdduna bi
Exile ak doxantu ba dee
Yookuté bu yàggul ak safara budul jeex
Defaraat bu yéeme ak xéewal gu mat ñaari yoon
outcome.answer: Yaxxum ñaari góob yi ci àdduna bi

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
